path.description: File path relative to the checkout root

line.description: First line of the code or text the finding is about

kind.description: defect: wrong behavior today. risk: correct today, wrong under a named input or state. config: a setting that contradicts another file or its tool. stale: text or a reference to something that no longer exists. standard: code that breaks a rule of this repository's AGENTS.md

severity.description: high: data loss, a wrong result, or a broken build. medium: wrong in a case users reach. low: wrong in a rare case or costly to maintain

issue.description: What is wrong, in one sentence

evidence.description: Input, call, or state that triggers it and what is then observed

verify.description: Command or read that shows it, and whether this run performed it

fix.description: Smallest change that removes the cause

notes.description: Observations of value that are not findings

unread.description: Every path of the share this run did not read whole
